description: A per-subject workflow graph: typed Nodes (Step / Branch / Assign / Wait / Terminal) + edges. Frozen on save into an immutable CRM Workflow Version; a running Instance binds to a version, never to this editable Definition. Ships dormant (enabled off).

fields.label: Workflow Name
fields.description: Names the workflow for operators; every Instance and log references it by this name.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Gates whether new Instances are created; disabling stops new starts but never touches Instances already running.

fields.label: Grain
fields.description: The grain a subject must match for this Flow to act is set here first. A Flow is evaluated only for a record whose lead grain (vertical / group / program) matches; a blank axis is a wildcard, so an empty grain matches every subject.

fields.label: Vertical
fields.description: Scopes the subjects that may enter; an Instance is created only when the subject's grain matches, mirroring the automation-rule grain gate. Blank axis = wildcard.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Scopes the subjects that may enter; blank = wildcard for this axis.

fields.label: Program
fields.description: Scopes the subjects that may enter; blank = wildcard for this axis.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.description: 1. Trigger. The doctype and lifecycle event that start the Flow are chosen here — for example a CRM Task, on Update. The Flow is evaluated only for records of the chosen doctype and event.

fields.label: Entry DocType
fields.description: Declares the doctype whose lifecycle event starts an Instance; it must be a resolvable subject.

fields.label: Entry Event
fields.description: Declares which lifecycle event - Created, Updated, or Deleted - starts an Instance.

fields.label: When (Criteria)
fields.description: 2. When. The criteria that must all hold for the Flow to act are composed here, over the allowlisted fields — for example outcome is "Physical Visit" and status changed to Done. Rows are combined with AND; an empty predicate matches every trigger of the chosen doctype and event.

fields.label: Criteria
fields.description: The predicate that must hold for the Flow to act, composed of the same operator vocabulary the automation engine uses (AND across rows). An empty predicate matches every trigger of the chosen doctype and event.

fields.label: Then (Actions)
fields.description: 3. Then. The actions are arranged here as an ordered graph of nodes. A Step runs an Action Group; a guard action within it (Require Fields / Require Location) is enforced at save time and can block the save, while every other action runs after. A Branch routes on a condition; a Wait parks the Flow until a timer or an event, turning it into a journey that resumes. A wait-free Flow runs once and persists nothing (a rule); a Flow that waits carries a durable instance.

fields.label: Nodes
fields.description: The graph: one row per node. Set each row's type and its handful of type-specific fields; edges reference other rows by Node ID.

name: CRM Workflow Definition
